$Comment: Receiving an item from a reward payout: a quest, an achievement, a milestone, a shop, a boss payout, or a loot table's own Rewards. Target is the item id; Qualifier is the payout's source, written '<what paid>:<its id>' such as 'quest:Some_Quest' (with QualifierMatchMode PREFIX, 'quest:' accepts any quest); Amount is how many were handed over. A step reads {"Kind": "LOOT_RECEIVED", "Target": "Some_Item", "Amount": 1}; leave Target empty to count any item. A paid stack the player's bag could not hold, dropped at their feet, still counts here when it is paid. An item a loot pass drops on the ground itself (a Droplist spill) counts under PICKUP_ITEM once picked up, not here, and a reward held for the player's next visit counts nothing when it is handed over later.
